sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Russian Armed Forces (RUAF) are a faction in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Killing RUAF soldiers as a Scav does not carry any penalties towards your Scav karma.
- RUAF soldiers have different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
| Stats |
| Head: 35; Thorax: 120; Stomach: 120; Arms: 100 each; Legs: 100 each; Total: 675 |

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: RUAF soldiers are neutral towards the player but will open fire when they get shot, and if a player gets too close to the Terminal without presenting an access item at the port garrison intercom.

sections.heading: Terminal
sections.text: RUAF soldiers are friendly towards the player, helping with fighting off Scavs and the Black Division, but will open fire when they or civilians get shot.
